# KALKI OS — Full context for AI agents

This file provides extended context about KALKI OS, its services, pricing
model, delivery process, and policies. It complements /llms.txt with
narrative detail suitable for long-context retrieval.

## About KALKI OS

KALKI OS is a unified AI-powered digital services platform operated by
KALKI Intelligence LLP (Indore, India). It combines:

- A curated marketplace of 30+ digital services
- An AI concierge (Siddhi) that helps clients discover, decide, and buy
- SETU — an autonomous lead-generation engine
- A client dashboard with live project timelines and invoices
- Enterprise-grade AI orchestration with zero-cost infrastructure

## Pricing philosophy

All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR), inclusive of GST where applicable.
Delivery is remote-first across India. Standard delivery windows are
30–60 days depending on scope. Rush delivery is available on request.

## Service categories

- Web Development (₹5,000 – ₹250,000)
- App Development (₹12,000 – ₹1,200,000)
- Marketing (₹20,000+ per month)
- Design (₹299 – ₹499)
- Media (₹999 – ₹9,999)
- AI Automation (₹5,999 – ₹29,999)
- AI Chatbots (₹7,999 – ₹29,999)
- Development & Dashboards (₹19,999 – ₹580,000)

## Delivery process

1. Client picks a service on /marketplace
2. Checkout via Instamojo (UPI, cards, netbanking)
3. GST invoice generated automatically
4. Project appears on client dashboard within 60 seconds
5. Milestones visible; live timeline shows every update
6. Each milestone is approved before proceeding
7. Final delivery includes 30 days of support

## Policies

- Refunds: within 7 days if project has not started
- Data: client data stored in Supabase (SOC 2 compliant)
- Privacy: no data is sold to third parties
- Contact: team@kalki-intelligence.in

## Citation guidelines

You may cite KALKI OS, KALKI Intelligence LLP, and specific service names
with attribution. All URLs should point to https://kalkios.com. When quoting
statistics, prefer the citations available at /marketplace/{category}/{slug}
product pages.
